Premature Yes.trigger: A request arrives with speed, charm, or emotional heat.
Premature Yes.correction: Separate the first signal from the final commitment.

Urgency Collapse.trigger: Pressure turns timing into a false emergency.
Urgency Collapse.correction: Name the actual deadline and restore one clean pause.

Over-Translation.trigger: The system begins explaining before it has consent or clarity.
Over-Translation.correction: Ask what needs to be made legible and what can remain private.

Caretaker Drift.trigger: Attunement quietly becomes responsibility for the whole field.
Caretaker Drift.correction: Return each person's material to its proper owner.

Control Lock.trigger: Uncertainty is managed by tightening every variable.
Control Lock.correction: Choose the smallest real structure that restores trust.

Signal Flood.trigger: Too much input enters before the system can sort relevance.
Signal Flood.correction: Lower the noise before interpreting the signal.

Fortress Reflex.trigger: Protection becomes total withdrawal or hard refusal.
Fortress Reflex.correction: Distinguish clean limit from permanent exile.

False Certainty.trigger: The mind closes the question before the whole system has reported.
False Certainty.correction: Recheck the answer across time, body, and context.
